big: Nifty Insurance is a snapshot of one slice of the market. Its factsheet answers four quick questions: how many stocks, what is the valuation, who is on top and how concentrated is it.

lines: What does the Nifty Insurance track?
Nifty Insurance aims to track the performance of all the Insurance stocks within the Nifty Total Market Index. It holds 11 stocks and is rebalanced twice a year.

intro: NSE factsheet, 30 Sep 2026, as per the lesson. Past returns do not predict the future.
